reproducibility_gaps: The repository lists dependencies but provides no reconstructable environment manifest or installation procedure and most dependency versions are not pinned.
ERA5 WeatherBench data are external and were not loaded or verified as a fixed local snapshot.
Hardware requirements and a fixed hardware profile are not documented in the bounded source.
Evaluation procedures are documented, but no machine-readable numerical acceptance thresholds were verified.
The released global checkpoint was identified statically but not loaded or evaluated.
notes: R1 reflects inspectable pinned source and documented use/evaluation commands, but the R2 environment-and-installation gate is not satisfied. The README lists prerequisites without an installation procedure; external data and a released checkpoint do not override that prerequisite.

reproducibility_gaps: The Zenodo archive internals could not be directly inspected in the bounded run, so source files, entrypoints and environment manifests remain unverified.
Archive license and dependency/version specifications remain unknown in the inspected evidence.
Random seeds and released trained checkpoints were not verified.
The paper reports institutional hardware support but not a reconstructable hardware configuration.
Paper-level experiment details do not substitute for direct source/archive inspection.
notes: R1 is conservative: paper and deposit relationship are verified, but archive-internal reproducibility evidence is not directly inspectable.
